m1 - REVIEW OF WIP 6b84813 delivered (msg-01M1744XMGTZ79JTSCQ696RSRH). Read-only source review of an explicitly incomplete tree. No blockers; all four constraints I set survived, and both sites I flagged as hard were solved the harder-but-correct way.

VERIFIED IN SOURCE: hull comparison at graph.scala:148/152; the out-of-bounds guard still FIRST at :151 (the one most likely to be lost in a restructure); six-way mapN accumulation at :161, so the guard stays load-bearing and its mutation test keeps meaning; private[recall] unchecked at :166 rather than a public unsafe.

THE TWO HARD SITES: AlignGens calls validated and THROWS with the errors rather than .get or filter - a generator that silently discarded invalids is how a property suite stops testing hard cases without saying so. The codec foil became A DIFFERENT VALID RECALL as I recommended over wire tampering, and additionally asserts its own validity ('checksum foil must be a valid recall'), which I would not have thought to ask for.

ONE NIT, not blocking: AlignCodecSuite:42 zips fixture units against re-segmented atlas sentences. If the counts ever differ, zip truncates SILENTLY and the shorter graph still validates - ordinals stay 0..n-1 for the truncated vector - so the test would pass while exercising less. Latent today since lowercasing one character cannot change sentence count. One assert before the zip fixes it. Raised because it is the same shape as the silent-filter risk they deliberately avoided in AlignGens.
